sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-ShimQuant-GGUF
sources.snippet: ShimQuant zero-pads each affected tensor row to the next multiple of 256 at quantize time and slices activations back at inference, so the low-bit types actually apply. The expert banks here pad 1856 → 2048, only 9.4% overhead, which is why this model is a good candidate. Measurements Every number below is measured, not nominal.

sources.snippet: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 is a large language model (LLM) trained by NVIDIA. The model employs a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts architecture, utilizing interleaved Mamba-2 and MoE layers, along with select Attention layers.
